notes.title: Announcing Astroblocks
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm thrilled to reveal Astroblocks along with its announcement trailer! 🎉

💌 Want to join the Beta?
Sign up for the mailing list—find the website link on the Steam page!

I'm a solo dev, and the game is in heavy development—working hard to get a demo in your hands soon!

Thanks for your support—I can't wait to share more!

Cheers,
Julien
